measurement.signal: Rec.709-like display-luma code derived from the exact post-tonemap PNG pixels
measurement.textureQualification: A comparison participates only when either endpoint has local one-pixel luma gradient at or above gradientThresholdCode. Smooth sky/wall fields therefore cannot create a high-confidence repetition signal merely by being smooth.
measurement.translationSweep: Horizontal and vertical translations are swept from minimumPeriodPx through maximumPeriodPx in periodStepPx increments.
measurement.localProminence: For each tested translation, compare its mean absolute luma difference with the median of nearby tested translations. A repeated tile/module can create a local difference trough even when ordinary spatial correlation changes with translation distance.
measurement.warningOnly: A prominence warning is triage evidence, not an automatic Visual Fidelity deduction or automatic critical FAIL. Perspective, legitimate manufactured modules and scene structure require human review of the exact pixels.
measurement.noClearanceByMetric: A low diagnostic signal cannot clear obvious_repetition. The reviewer must explicitly inspect every required crop and record observed evidence in visual_fidelity_evidence.json.

hardRules: Diagnostics may run only after an actual Unity-produced native 3840x2160 manifest exists.
Each analyzed crop must be one of the canonical pixel-exact 100% capture records and is SHA-256 bound into the diagnostics report.
The diagnostics report must bind the current 4k_capture_manifest.json SHA-256 and every analyzed crop SHA-256 before Visual Fidelity scoring is allowed.
Warnings may direct corrective work but never award Visual Fidelity points.
No diagnostic result, including zero warnings, may automatically clear the obvious_repetition critical defect.
Do not randomize authentic manufactured dimensions merely to reduce the metric; repeated manufactured structure can be legitimate and must be judged from real construction plus the render.
Do not hide repetition with blur, bloom, depth of field, sharpening or exposure manipulation.
